idea: Colors & shapes – colors #2 (LITTLE STARS NURSERY, Jimmy in HOME onesie at the small round nursery table): hook 'Wow! A big blue crayon!' – Jimmy gasps at a big chunky sparkling BLUE crayon held up right beside his face; say-it-with-me 'Blue, blue, blue! Say it with me!'; ORANGE: 'Orange, orange! Orange like an orange!' (blue crayon now lies on the table); PURPLE: 'Purple, purple! Purple like grapes!'; copy-me chorus 'Colors, colors! Clap with me! Blue and orange and purple, see!' with the three crayons standing in a neat row; question to the viewer 'Which one is purple? Hmm?' (2 s pause) – 'This one! Purple! Yay!' as he taps the purple crayon; lesson 'I know my colors!'. Loop: the hook framing again, now all three crayons standing in a row, bye-bye wave.
title: Wow! A Big Blue Crayon! 🖍️ Learn Colors with Baby Jimmy | Blue, Orange, Purple | Crayon Babies
description:
Wow! Baby Jimmy finds a big blue crayon at Little Stars Nursery! 🖍️ Sing along with Jimmy and learn three colors – blue, orange and purple – then help him find the purple one.

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Wow! A big blue crayon!" – blue, blue, blue! Say it with me!
🍊 Orange, orange! Orange like an orange!
🍇 Purple, purple! Purple like grapes!
👏 Colors, colors! Clap with me!
🤔 "Which one is purple?" – can you point to it? PURPLE! Yay!
👋 I know my colors! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: colors for toddlers • blue • orange • purple • find the purple one • color words in English

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A fun colors song for toddlers and preschoolers: Baby Jimmy sits at his little nursery table with three big chunky crayons, names each color, claps along and asks you to find the purple crayon. After watching, look around your home – can you find something blue, orange and purple?
